ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-to-peer micro-marketplace for RV University students featuring automated dispute resolution and secure USDC escrows on Base.
ideas.title: CampusEscrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning formula of combining autonomous escrow infrastructure with a hyper-local student market, matching the pattern seen in the Synthesis Hackathon win.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutritional analysis and smart menu planner tailored specifically for Indian university hostel messes and student dining halls.
ideas.title: Mess-AI Nutrition Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an immediate daily pain point felt by every student and faculty member in the room—bad hostel food and nutrition—matching the localized problem-solving pattern.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and drone-imagery monitoring dashboard to track green cover and construction waste compliance across large university and industrial campuses.
ideas.title: EcoCompliant-RVU
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves complex environmental auditing challenges using geospatial intelligence, mirroring the technical approach of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven logistics and volunteer dispatch application designed to coordinate weekend transit and social outings for elderly residents in Bengaluru neighborhoods near RV University.
ideas.title: ElderRide Campus Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear, quantifiable social impact and community value, directly replicating the winning blueprint of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An explainable graph-based risk intelligence platform for detecting anomalous transaction patterns in regional fintech onboarding flows.
ideas.title: RiskLens AML India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases genuinely hard engineering by implementing graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models, aligning with the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner.
